title: WhatsApp Desktop data
whyItMatters: WhatsApp stores local chat caches, media and session state. The folder reveals that the account was used on this Mac.
source: macfor knowledge base, WhatsApp Desktop on macOS: the Catalyst app keeps ChatStorage.sqlite in ~/Library/Group Containers/group.net.whatsapp.WhatsApp.shared
notes: Current Catalyst app. The deprecated Electron build used ~/Library/Application Support/WhatsApp (not covered). Group Containers may need Full Disk Access.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save the photos and files you still need from the chats, because the local copies on this Mac are removed.
cleanup.signOut: On the phone open WhatsApp settings and remove this Mac from the linked devices list, so it stops receiving messages.
steps: Quit WhatsApp so its files are not in use.
Move WhatsApp to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the group.net.whatsapp.WhatsApp.shared folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: The local chat cache and media on this Mac are removed. The conversations stay on the phone.
cleanup.source: WhatsApp, How to unlink a device: https://faq.whatsapp.com/834124628020911
